sloka: ते निवृत्य तु सङ्क्रुद्धाः कुम्भकर्णं वनौकसः।निजघ्नुः परमक्रुद्धाः समदा इव कुञ्जराः ।। ६.६६.९ ।।
transliteration: te nivṛtya tu saṅkruddhāḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ vanaukasaḥ।nijaghnuḥ paramakruddhāḥ samadā iva kuñjarāḥ ।। 6.66.9 ।।

translations.english: Those forest rangers who were extremely enraged turned back to hit, determined like the elephants in rut went to vanquish Kumbhakarna.
